name: v0.31.0
body:
## What's Changed
* docs(release): close v0.30.2 publication evidence by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/185
* Align dialog action footers with Save before Cancel by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/186
* feat(settings): add query restoration and theme preferences by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/187
* Fix Light contrast and persistence/indexing validation by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/188
* chore(release): prepare v0.31.0 and register v0.30.2 updater capability by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/189
* fix(ci): retain Linux coverage fault stacks and repair candidate validation by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/190
* docs(ci): prove restored protection after Linux diagnostic rollout by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/191
* fix(gui): show indexing source and keep tab controls visible by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/193
* Fix font-dependent clipping in Root selector and shared rows by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/194
* Fix multiline Root labels and offscreen row layout regressions by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/195
* fix(deps): patch TLS certificate distrust vulnerabilities by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/196
* test: bound TC-151 completion by work and progress by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/197
* fix: isolate indexing and add stop/refresh recovery controls by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/198
* fix: prepare Browse off-thread and diagnose TC-207 timing by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/199
* test: retain TC-207 timing evidence and handle Finished offer revocation by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/200
* Prepare v0.31.0 release and repair CI/clipboard warning blockers by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/201
* Retain v0.31.0 CI restoration and prove protected release route by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/202
* Bind completed protected proof to v0.31.0 execution packet by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/203
* Fix Windows release README command expansion before v0.31.0 by @ShinjiKawamura255 in https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/pull/204


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShinjiKawamura255/flist-walker/compare/v0.30.2...v0.31.0
